title: WalletRecord
description: BibleFi wallet record representing an EVM-compatible wallet participating in the BibleFi protocol.

wallet_id.description: Unique identifier for this wallet record.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the wallet_record schema used.

chain_ids.description: List of EIP-155 chain IDs this wallet is active on.

ens_name.description: ENS or other name-service domain associated with this wallet address.

label.description: Human-readable label for this wallet (internal use).

owner_id.description: UUID reference to the user_profile that owns this wallet.

church_id.description: UUID reference to a church_record if this wallet belongs to a church.

balance_snapshot.description: Point-in-time snapshot of wallet token balances.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this balance snapshot was taken.

tokens.description: List of token balances at snapshot time.

contract_address.description: EVM contract address of the token. Omit for native currency.

amount.description: Token balance as a string to preserve precision (e.g. '1234567890000000000' wei).

amount_usd.description: USD value of this token balance at snapshot time.

is_treasury.description: Whether this wallet serves as a church treasury.

verified.description: Whether this wallet has been verified by the BibleFi protocol.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update.
